suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as post traumatic epilepsy risk. Require documented traumatic skull fracture and separately diagnosed subsequent epilepsy. Do not equate acute provoked seizures with epilepsy, and preserve the source population/age limitations when applying the evidence. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Skull Fracture (Non-basilar and Basal) matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Epilepsy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented traumatic skull fracture and separately diagnosed subsequent epilepsy. Do not equate acute provoked seizures with epilepsy, and preserve the source population/age limitations when applying the evidence.
